project.name: zalo-assistant-bot
project.description: Zalo assistant bot (Zalo Bot Platform) powered by Gemini, replying in group chats via polling. Includes a FastAPI admin UI and CLI entry point. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.

nodes.summary: Central typed Settings dataclass loaded from environment/.env with validation helpers and secret checks for the bot.

nodes.name: _csv
nodes.summary: Splits a comma-separated string into a tuple of trimmed values.

nodes.name: _int
nodes.summary: Parses an integer environment variable with default and minimum bound.

nodes.name: _bool

nodes.name: ConfigError

nodes.name: Settings

nodes.name: AlreadyRunning
nodes.summary: Exception raised when another instance holds the lock.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package marker for the system management subpackage.

nodes.name: auto_update.py

nodes.name: update
nodes.summary: Runs the git pull and pip install update flow and returns an UpdateResult.

nodes.name: bot_process.py

nodes.name: run_hidden

nodes.name: status_info

nodes.name: Service
nodes.summary: Descriptor of a managed service (bot or GUI) with its names and lock/pid settings.

nodes.name: Result

nodes.name: first_run_setup.py
nodes.summary: First-run bootstrap that creates the userdata home with template files and guarantees an admin access token in .env.

nodes.name: ensure_home
nodes.summary: Creates missing userdata directories and template files and returns the created list.

nodes.name: ensure_admin_token
nodes.summary: Generates and persists a random admin token to .env when absent.

nodes.name: validate_bundle

nodes.name: handover_job.py

nodes.name: _to_local

nodes.name: JobError

nodes.name: Job

nodes.name: LastError

nodes.name: upload_sync

nodes.name: RemoteError

nodes.name: Reply
nodes.summary: Simple dataclass wrapping an HTTP reply from the VPS.

nodes.name: server_info.py

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package marker for the admin web UI subpackage.

nodes.summary: Entry point launching the desktop GUI, with options for tray-only, auto-start bot and after-update.

nodes.name: Desktop

nodes.name: userdata_paths.py

nodes.summary: Finds member IDs whose name matches a query by exact, single-word, then prefix match after accent folding.

nodes.name: is_chatter

nodes.name: Job

nodes.name: Bot

nodes.name: owner_commands.py

nodes.name: help_text
nodes.summary: Builds the help message listing commands allowed for a role.

nodes.name: ParsedCommand
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass with a command name and its lowercase argument.

nodes.name: parse_command
nodes.summary: Parses '/cmd arg' text into a ParsedCommand if the command is known.

nodes.name: describe_mode
nodes.summary: Describes the all/default reply mode in Vietnamese.

nodes.name: CommandHandler
nodes.summary: Executes slash commands with role checks against group, history and usage stores, returning reply text.

nodes.name: _pick_people
nodes.summary: Picks Zalo IDs from real mentions, or by name matching or raw numeric IDs, reporting names not found.

nodes.name: rate_limiter.py
nodes.summary: In-memory sliding-window per-minute rate limiter keyed by user or chat.

nodes.name: reply_formatting.py

nodes.name: utf16_len
nodes.summary: Counts text length in UTF-16 code units.

nodes.name: _max_prefix

nodes.name: split_message
nodes.summary: Splits text into chunks within the limit, preferring paragraph, line, sentence then space boundaries.

nodes.name: to_plain_text
nodes.summary: Strips bold, heading and bullet markdown into plain text for Zalo.

nodes.name: roles.py
nodes.summary: Defines the basic/leader/owner role hierarchy and maps commands to the minimum role required.

nodes.name: role_of
nodes.summary: Determines a user's role: owner, leader (all-assign or group leader) or basic.

nodes.name: required_role
nodes.summary: Returns the minimum role for a command and argument.

nodes.name: allows
nodes.summary: Checks whether a role rank meets the needed rank.

nodes.name: text_fold.py
nodes.summary: Normalizes text to lowercase without Vietnamese diacritics for accent-insensitive comparison.

nodes.name: fold
nodes.summary: Lowercases, maps d-stroke to d and strips combining marks via NFD.

nodes.name: __init__.py

nodes.name: data_stores.py

nodes.name: GroupState

nodes.name: safe_name

nodes.name: MemoryDataStore

nodes.name: UsageStore

nodes.name: StatsStore

nodes.name: ActivityStore
nodes.summary: Records last activity, type and name per chat.

nodes.name: FailedStore

nodes.name: text_files.py

nodes.name: atomic_write_text

nodes.name: JsonLinesFile

nodes.name: JsonObjectFile
nodes.summary: JSON object file wrapper with safe read and atomic write.

nodes.name: receive_webhook.py
nodes.summary: FastAPI app factory exposing the authenticated Zalo webhook endpoint and a health check.

nodes.name: create_app
nodes.summary: Creates a FastAPI app with a secret-validated POST webhook that forwards payloads to the handler, and a /health endpoint.

nodes.name: __main__.py
nodes.summary: Module entry point for python -m bot that delegates to command_line.main and exits with its return code.

nodes.languageNotes: Blocking requests-based flow with a threading.Event for cancellation; meant to run in a worker thread.

nodes.name: _rejects_thinking

nodes.name: _CachedFile

nodes.name: Tool

nodes.name: _load_external
nodes.summary: Loads user-written tool modules from a directory, skipping underscore files and isolating failures.

nodes.name: discover

nodes.name: _current_time
nodes.summary: Example handler returning current Vietnam time and timezone.

nodes.name: _build_agent
nodes.summary: Creates tool registry and a GeminiAgent from settings, or an EchoAgent when allowed and no key is set.

nodes.summary: Starts background tasks for syncing settings and heartbeat with the schedule web server when an API key is set.

nodes.name: _bot_status

nodes.name: _health

nodes.name: _zalo_login

nodes.name: _update

nodes.name: _admin
nodes.summary: Controls the admin web UI process: run, start, stop, restart, status.

nodes.name: _prepare_home
nodes.summary: Migrates legacy data into userdata once and creates missing sample folders/files.

nodes.name: _utf8_console
nodes.summary: Forces UTF-8 console output streams.

nodes.name: _attach_parent_console
nodes.summary: Attaches the windowed exe to the parent cmd console to print command output.

nodes.summary: Parses CLI arguments with argparse subcommands and dispatches to the matching handler.

nodes.name: ConsoleZalo
nodes.summary: Fake Zalo client that prints bot replies and chat actions to the terminal.

nodes.summary: Returns the current epoch time in milliseconds.

nodes.name: now_vn

nodes.summary: Returns today's Vietnam date as an ISO string.

nodes.name: QrLoginError

nodes.name: FakeWeb

nodes.name: make_settings
nodes.summary: Builds a Settings object from an isolated env dict rooted in tmp_path, with rate limits and budget disabled and per-test overrides.

nodes.name: event

nodes.name: make_bot

nodes.name: web

nodes.name: test_bot.py

nodes.name: test_desktop.py

nodes.name: test_filter.py

nodes.name: msg

nodes.name: test_memorydata.py

nodes.name: FakeApi

nodes.name: test_remote_config.py

nodes.name: fold_same_length

nodes.name: add_tags
nodes.summary: Inserts '@' before member names in a reply when the request shows tag/remind/call intent and the name appears in both request and reply, avoiding overlaps with longer names.

nodes.summary: Package init re-exporting the Zalo Bot Platform client, error type and incoming-message parsing helpers.

nodes.name: ZaloError
nodes.summary: Exception for Zalo API failures (ok=false) or network errors, carrying description, error_code and a network flag.

nodes.name: ZaloClient
nodes.summary: Async client posting to the bot API; call() parses JSON, raises ZaloError with the token redacted, and thin methods cover get_me, get_updates, send_message, send_chat_action and webhook calls.

nodes.name: incoming_message.py
nodes.summary: Defines the IncomingMessage dataclass and parsers that normalize Zalo webhook or getUpdates payloads (object, list, wrapped or not) into message objects with dedupe keys.

nodes.name: IncomingMessage
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass for a normalized incoming Zalo event with chat/sender info, text, mentions and is_group, is_text and dedupe_key helpers.

nodes.name: parse_event
nodes.summary: Converts one raw event dict into an IncomingMessage, returning None when message, chat id or sender id is missing.

nodes.name: parse_updates
nodes.summary: Accepts a webhook payload or getUpdates result in any shape and returns the list of valid IncomingMessage objects.

nodes.name: receive_polling.py
nodes.summary: Long-polling receive loop using getUpdates: removes any webhook, then polls with exponential backoff, tolerating timeouts and network errors, and records heartbeat state.

nodes.name: run_polling
nodes.summary: Runs the never-exiting getUpdates loop, deleting the webhook first, handling 408 timeouts, network errors and unexpected exceptions with backoff and de-duplicated logging, and passing results to the handler.

nodes.name: _sleep_or_stop
nodes.summary: Sleeps for given seconds but wakes early if the stop event is set.

nodes.name: personal_account.py
nodes.summary: Runs the bot on a personal Zalo account via the unofficial zlapi library: loads a QR-login session, listens over websocket in a background thread, forwards messages to the event loop, and sends replies with group mention support.
nodes.languageNotes: Bridges synchronous zlapi to asyncio using run_coroutine_threadsafe and asyncio.to_thread; defines a dynamic subclass of ZaloAPI inside login().

nodes.name: load_session
nodes.summary: Reads the session file in several formats (QR-login JSON, cookie dict, or cookie list) and returns cookies, IMEI and user agent, raising ConfigError on problems.

nodes.name: to_incoming
nodes.summary: Maps zlapi onMessage arguments into an IncomingMessage, marking own messages as bot-sent to avoid self-replies.

nodes.name: mention_names
nodes.summary: Extracts {uid: name} from mention entries of a message by slicing text with UTF-16 offsets, skipping @All.

nodes.name: PersonalZalo
nodes.summary: Personal-account transport with ZaloClient-compatible send_message and send_chat_action; handles login, websocket listening thread, group member caching, learned mention names and mention-aware sending.

nodes.name: _is_network_error
nodes.summary: Walks the exception cause chain to decide whether a zlapi login failure is really a network error.

nodes.name: _log_failure
nodes.summary: Done-callback that logs exceptions from handler futures scheduled onto the event loop.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package marker for the Windows desktop app (WebView2 window plus system tray icon); contains only a docstring.

nodes.name: icon_images.py
nodes.summary: Draws the app icon with Pillow (blue rounded square with a Z and an optional status dot), so no image assets are needed in the repo.

nodes.name: tray_icon.py
nodes.summary: System tray integration using pystray; builds a dynamic menu delegating to the Desktop controller and updates icon/title as the bot state changes.

nodes.name: windows_autostart.py
nodes.summary: Manages start-with-Windows via an HKCU Run registry entry, including command construction for frozen or source runs and migration of stale entries.
nodes.languageNotes: winreg is imported lazily inside functions and guarded by os.name checks so the module is importable on non-Windows.

nodes.name: make_icon
nodes.summary: Renders a supersampled (4x) RGBA rounded-square icon with a white Z, optionally adding a colored state dot at the bottom right, then downsizes with LANCZOS.

nodes.name: write_ico
nodes.summary: Writes a multi-size .ico file (16 to 256 px) to the given path, creating parent directories; used at build time for the executable.

nodes.name: Tray
nodes.summary: Wraps a pystray Icon whose menu items (toggle/restart bot, update, VPS move, autostart, quit) call into the Desktop controller; supports run, stop, notify, refresh and autostart toggling.

nodes.name: command
nodes.summary: Builds the command line stored in the Run key: the frozen executable or pythonw.exe -m bot, with 'gui --tray --start-bot'.

nodes.name: is_enabled
nodes.summary: Returns True when the Run key value exists and equals the current command; always False off Windows.

nodes.name: set_enabled
nodes.summary: Creates or deletes the HKCU Run value for autostart; raises OSError on non-Windows.

nodes.name: migrate
nodes.summary: If autostart is already enabled but points to a different command, rewrites it to the current one; never enables it on its own.

nodes.name: schedule_web.py
nodes.summary: Registers Vietnamese-named agent tools (add event, add task, view agenda, list tasks, complete task) that call the time-management web API. Tools are only exposed when SCHEDULE_API_KEY is configured and default to owner-only.

nodes.name: server_client.py
nodes.summary: HTTP client for the iforgotmywayhome web agent API: reads URL and key from settings.env/environment, normalizes the base URL, and performs authenticated async requests returning error dicts instead of raising.

nodes.name: session_upload.py
nodes.summary: Buffers session steps in a bounded in-memory queue and uploads them in batches to the web /sessions endpoint from a background loop, tolerating network failures without affecting the bot.

nodes.name: _request
nodes.summary: Wraps server_client.request, collapsing error responses to a plain {error} dict.

nodes.name: _note
nodes.summary: Appends a 'created via Zalo by <user>' attribution line to the optional note.

nodes.name: _create_event
nodes.summary: Tool handler that POSTs a new calendar event (title, start, optional end/allDay, note) to /events.

nodes.name: _create_task
nodes.summary: Tool handler that POSTs a to-do with optional deadline and Eisenhower quadrant to /tasks.

nodes.name: _agenda
nodes.summary: Tool handler that fetches the agenda for a given date (default today) via GET /agenda.

nodes.name: _list_tasks
nodes.summary: Tool handler that lists pending tasks via GET /tasks, wrapping the list under a 'tasks' key.

nodes.name: _complete_task
nodes.summary: Tool handler that marks a task done via PATCH /tasks/{id}, validating and URL-quoting the id.

nodes.name: _owner_only
nodes.summary: Reads SCHEDULE_OWNER_ONLY from settings and returns whether tools are restricted to the bot owner (default true).

nodes.name: _tools
nodes.summary: Builds the list of five Tool definitions with descriptions and JSON-schema parameters; returns empty when no API key is configured.

nodes.name: env_values
nodes.summary: Merges settings.env values with os.environ into one dict, for contexts that do not load settings.env into the environment.

nodes.name: base_url
nodes.summary: Normalizes a web or API address to end with /api/agent, falling back to DEFAULT_URL.

nodes.name: server_config
nodes.summary: Returns the (base URL, API key) pair from the current environment configuration.

nodes.name: configured
nodes.summary: True when an API key is present.

nodes.name: request
nodes.summary: Async httpx call to the agent API with Bearer auth; returns parsed JSON or an {error,status,message} dict on missing key, network failure, non-JSON, or HTTP errors.

nodes.name: SessionUploader
nodes.summary: Queues session events (deque capped at 1000), flushes them in batches of 100 to POST /sessions, requeues on failure preserving order, and runs a periodic background loop.

nodes.name: PROJECT_MAP.md
nodes.summary: Vietnamese project navigation map with a 2D architecture matrix, a quick-lookup table by need, and per-file purpose and relationship details for the bot's source modules.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Main user guide covering installation on Windows, first run with Zalo, desktop app, admin web UI, webhook and personal-account modes, group filters, schedule integration, command reference and tool extension.

nodes.name: ZaloBot.cmd
nodes.summary: Windows batch launcher that creates a virtualenv and installs the package with desktop and personal extras on first run, then starts the management GUI via pythonw (python -m bot gui), forwarding arguments.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses goto labels (:run, :nopython, :failed) for control flow; ASCII-only comments because cmd reads legacy codepages.

nodes.name: pyproject.toml
nodes.summary: Setuptools project metadata for zalo-assistant-bot: core dependencies, optional extras (dev, personal, desktop, build), the zalo-bot CLI entry point, package data and pytest settings.

nodes.name: PLAN.md
nodes.summary: Vietnamese master plan for the Zalo AI agent bot server, covering decisions, Zalo channel choice, architecture, directory layout, message flow, security, roadmap and risks. Also holds plans and progress for the web management dashboard, the Windows .exe wrapper, and VPS remote control.

nodes.name: lenh-zalo.md
nodes.summary: User guide for the bot's Zalo commands, describing the three roles (basic-user, leader, owner) and a table of slash commands with minimum role and effect.

nodes.name: vps-dieu-khien.md
nodes.summary: Explains controlling the bot on a VPS from the Windows ZaloBot.exe app: remote API proxying, standby mode, handover package between machines, and Gmail-based VPS connection.

nodes.name: build-exe.ps1
nodes.summary: Builds the one-file windowed ZaloBot.exe with PyInstaller, scans the output for leaked secrets, and copies the exe next to userdata unless -NoCopy is given.
nodes.languageNotes: Requires ASCII-only content because Windows PowerShell 5.1 reads BOM-less files as ANSI.

nodes.name: install-task.ps1
nodes.summary: Registers Windows Task Scheduler tasks that launch the bot and the admin UI at logon through run-forever.ps1, with unlimited run time and auto-restart.

nodes.name: run-forever.ps1
nodes.summary: Supervisor loop that runs the bot or admin UI via python -m bot and restarts it after exit, logging to supervisor.log and stopping on exit codes 2, 3 and 5.

nodes.name: uninstall-task.ps1
nodes.summary: Stops and unregisters the bot and admin scheduled tasks, then force-kills leftover python processes running the bot or admin command.

nodes.name: Register-BotTask
nodes.summary: Creates a hidden PowerShell scheduled-task action with a logon trigger and restart-on-failure settings, registers it, and starts it immediately.

nodes.name: admin_page.css
nodes.summary: Layout and component styles for the bot admin page: grid layout with sticky topbar and side nav, headings, and page-specific blocks built on the shared theme variables.
nodes.languageNotes: Relies on CSS custom properties and color-mix() defined in theme.css.

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: Single-page shell of the Vietnamese admin UI: SVG icon sprite, token/Gmail login form, and an app layout with topbar (target switch, status pill, theme toggle, logout), nav and main container populated by admin_page.js.

nodes.name: theme.css
nodes.summary: Shared 'iforgotmywayhome' theme with self-hosted font-faces, dark-default and light color tokens, pastel accents, and base styles for buttons, inputs and cards; kept in sync with a copy from another repo.
nodes.languageNotes: Dark theme default; light mode via html[data-theme=light].

nodes.name: .gitattributes

nodes.name: ZaloBot.spec
nodes.summary: PyInstaller spec that builds a windowed single-file ZaloBot.exe from zalobot_entry.py, bundling package data and hidden imports (uvicorn, google.genai, zlapi) while excluding userdata.

nodes.name: check_secrets.py
nodes.summary: Post-build audit script that scans the PyInstaller exe and build dir for forbidden files and secret values read from settings.env; exits 1 on any finding.

nodes.name: secrets_from_env
nodes.summary: Reads the secret keys (bot token, Gemini key, admin token, webhook secret) from an env file and returns their UTF-8 and UTF-16-LE byte forms for searching.

nodes.name: check_exe
nodes.summary: Walks the PyInstaller archive TOC flagging bundled env/userdata files, then searches each entry and the raw exe bytes for secret values.

nodes.name: check_dir
nodes.summary: Recursively scans files under a build directory (under 200MB) for secret byte values and reports offending paths.

nodes.name: version_info.txt

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README, which covers Windows installation, first run with Zalo, the desktop app and the admin UI. PROJECT_MAP.md adds a navigation map of the architecture, so together they frame the bot before you open any code.

tour.title: Entry Points and CLI
tour.description: pyproject.toml declares the package and its optional extras, and the CLI entry bot.cli:main resolves to command_line.py. That file has a fan-out of 9 and is the argparse front door: run, console, webhook management, gateway/admin control. __main__.py and the PyInstaller zalobot_entry.py both delegate to it, so every launch path converges here.
tour.languageLesson: Python console scripts: the [project.scripts] table in pyproject.toml maps a command name to a module:function, and python -m package runs __main__.py.

tour.title: Configuration and Paths
tour.description: config.py (fan-in 18) holds the typed Settings dataclass loaded from the environment or .env with validation. userdata_paths.py (fan-in 13) resolves where userdata lives, for a frozen exe versus source. Nearly everything later depends on these two, so learn them first.

tour.title: Persistence Layer
tour.description: The storage package is a barrel that re-exports file-backed stores. text_files.py supplies atomic writes and JSON-lines wrappers, and data_stores.py builds group settings, chat history and memory on top of them. vietnam_time.py (fan-in 14) is the shared fixed UTC+7 time helper these stores use.

tour.title: Receiving Zalo Messages
tour.description: The zalo package normalizes incoming messages into the IncomingMessage dataclass. They arrive via long polling, an authenticated FastAPI webhook, or a personal account through the unofficial zlapi library. The Bot Platform client handles outgoing calls.

tour.title: The Message Orchestrator
tour.description: message_handler.py (fan-out 12) is the central Bot class. It owns the stores, filter, commands and rate limiters, and queues work per chat. It builds on the stores from Step 4 and the incoming messages from Step 5.

tour.title: Roles and Commands
tour.description: roles.py defines the basic/leader/owner hierarchy and the minimum role each command needs. owner_commands.py parses slash commands and enforces those roles. docs/lenh-zalo.md documents the same commands for end users.

tour.title: Gemini Agent
tour.description: Messages that pass the filter reach GeminiAgent, which runs a bounded function-calling loop with retries. The system prompt is built from hot-reloaded SYSTEM.md and MEMORY.md, and ToolRegistry discovers tool modules. Reply formatting then prepares the answer for Zalo's length limits.

tour.title: Agent Tools
tour.description: Tools give the model abilities such as scheduling events, assigning calendar items and reading chat memory. A template (_example.py) shows how to declare a new tool, and users can drop in their own.

tour.title: Process and System Operations
tour.description: bot_process.py controls the bot lifecycle: PID files, locks, spawn, stop and restart. Around it sit auto_update, handover between local and VPS, remote config sync and the remote server client. Together they let one codebase run on a desktop or a server.

tour.title: Admin Web UI
tour.description: admin_web_server.py has the highest fan-out in the project (21). This FastAPI factory wires auth, bot control, handover, groups and history. The static index.html and admin_page.js form a single-page front end served from it, and settings_file.py edits .env safely.

tour.title: Desktop App
tour.description: desktop_app.py hosts the admin server inside a native window and controls the bot, with a pystray tray menu and a Windows autostart entry. It is the user-facing shell over the admin UI from Step 11.

tour.title: Packaging and Deployment
tour.description: ZaloBot.cmd bootstraps a virtualenv, and build-exe.ps1 with the PyInstaller spec produces a single-file ZaloBot.exe. check_secrets.py audits the build for leaked files. Task Scheduler and supervisor scripts keep it running, and docs/vps-dieu-khien.md explains VPS control.

tour.title: Test Suite
tour.description: conftest.py provides fake Zalo and Gemini fixtures used by many tests. test_bot.py and test_roles.py cover the orchestrator and role rules, and test_admin.py and test_handover.py cover the admin API and data transfer.
